Name: Jeelh's Farm Buildings
Author: Jeelh
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/FGalk28.png[/img]

This is a complete seasonal farm building replacement mod.

Plenty of styles, materials, and colours to choose from for every building type that is placeable on the farm.

Most things in this mod can be disabled. So if you dislike something you can turn it off with GMCM.


NOW COMPATIBLE WITH
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]
& [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCilBwk.png[/img]

﻿[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[b]2[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]3[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b]4[/b]. Download Jeelh's Farm Buildings
[b]5[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
[b]6[/b]. Launch the game and use GMCM to customise this mod to your liking


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jtASrD2.png[/img]

1.0.0
- Initial release
:)

1.1.0
- Added buildings for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿: Winery, Grandpa's Shed, Premium Barn, and Premium Coop
- 6 new Colour variations for every paint-able building: Blue, Red, Yellow, Green, Purple, and White
- New Stable style: Garage, also with the 6 Colour variations
- Added the garage from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]﻿
- All new buildings have seasonal overlays
- Small changes to the Stone Mailbox and Wood Greenhouse
- Small fixes to all Cabin Winter textures
- Junimo Huts can now be disabled with GMCM

There is currently a bug with Grandpa's Shed on some of the SVE farm maps, where the map is overlayed on top of the completed shed.
I have tested other mods and they also have the same issue, which unfortunately means that it probably isn't something I can fix myself.
But if the visual glitch is annoying, you can always disable my Grandpa's Shed via GMCM! :)

Thanks to Stardew Valley Expanded and the Tractor Mod creators for their amazing mods.

1.1.1
- Added textures for the Ginger Island Farmhouse
- Fixed a line of pixels on Grandpa's Shed for SVE
- Changed Wood Colour to Panels Colour for all Barns and Coops
You might need to choose your options again in the config menu due to the name changes

1.1.2
- Finally added decorations to the pack! You can enable them with GMCM for the Farmhouse, Deluxe Barn, Deluxe Coop, Shed, and all of the SVE buildings.
- Added new options for the Pet Bowl. A vanilla seasonal option, one with only the bowl, and a new pet bed option that comes in 10 colours!
- New textures for all fence types! Slightly shorter seasonal wooden fences, a more consistent seasonal stone fence, and a seasonal metal fence!
- Small fixes and name changes to other buildings.

1.1.3
- Added new looks for the Plank, Rustic, and Neighbor Cabins, to match the overall look of the pack.
- Added new colours for the Doghouses

1.1.4
- Added optional coloured gems to Obelisk statues.

1.2.0
- New compatibility option for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].
- Textures for Shane's Coop, 8 colour options.
- New panels colours for the Farmhouse.

1.2.1
- New compatibility option for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url].
- New brown panels colour for the Farmhouse. Inspired by Shane's Coop from my previous update.

1.2.2
-Split the Earthy and Vibrant recolours into their own downloads to save on file size, in the optional downloads section.


﻿[/center]
